correctness.rationale: Composition of decreasing clipped affine maps yields exactly T(z)=clip(B+(-1)^nWz;L,H), with endpoints L,H following the stated min/max recurrences and all intermediate actions recovered from z. For W<1 Banach contraction applies. For even W=1, T is a translated projection, absorbed at an endpoint or instantly fixed. For even W>1, the interior of an expanding clipped-affine map pushes every nonfixed point to a fixed endpoint plateau in finitely many steps; there are at most three fixed points. Odd cycles have decreasing T, whose exact square is increasing clipped affine of slope W^2, giving critical idempotence or supercritical finite plateau capture; uniqueness of T fixed point leaves at most one 2-cycle. Endpoint and r=-b/(a-1) cases accounted for. Independent exact-rational compositions include heterogeneity; source VERIFY.py inspected. Finite checks corroborate but do not prove universal iteration.
